name: Phantom Muspah
dataSource: Monster statistics: OSRS Wiki via bundled monsters.json. Strategy notes: OSRS Wiki Phantom Muspah/Strategies.
validationNotes: Per-form DPS is covered by reference validation. How long the Muspah spends in each form varies from kill to kill; the phase weights are an assumption. The prayer-shield phase is modelled only as a short ranged phase against the published 'Shielded' statistics.
warnings: The Muspah changes form during the fight: its ranged form has very high magic defence and its melee form has very high ranged defence.
Phase weights are assumptions; compare the per-phase DPS figures rather than only the weighted total.

strategies.name: Ranged + magic switches
strategies.description: Ranged against the ranged form, shield and post-shield; magic against the melee form.

inventory.reason: Magic boost for the melee form

strategies.name: Ranged only
strategies.description: One ranged setup for the whole fight. Noticeably weaker against the melee form.
